item.title: From Files to Cited Answers in One API Call: Managed Ingestion and SearchDocuments in Agent Retrieval
item.description: Agent Retrieval in Vertex AI introduces managed ingestion and SearchDocuments to replace custom chunking and embedding pipelines Developers can now import document and video files directly from Cloud Storage and query them with a single API call for cited page numbers and timestamped results The feature supports hybrid retrieval, metadata filtering, reranking, and multimodal video audio search.

item.title: Art of play in the age of AI
item.description: Now that code ships faster than ever, you have more time to spend on projects just for the fun of it Here's what we can learn through that process as developers The post Art of play in the age of AI appeared first on The GitHub Blog.

item.title: How to choose the next safe step in application modernization
item.description: Learn how to assess a legacy application, choose a bounded modernization step, and reuse the method with a GitHub Copilot agent skill The post How to choose the next safe step in application modernization appeared first on The GitHub Blog.

item.title: Introducing Search for Agents
item.description: Flip one toggle to make your site searchable by AI agents — complete with automatic content indexing, a discoverable search API, and native HTTP QUERY support.
